output.reason: The brief explains every clue: the timing, why the Press 7 trial passed, why Quillan was fine on the wet D5 dryer, and the shift gap. It backs this with a same-lot comparison (0.8% through a good dryer against 10.4% through D5) and gives concrete actions for this week. The 0.20% moisture limit doesn't match the 0.35% spec on the certificates of analysis and isn't explained, and the role of the annex storage is still open.
